header.name: Expandable Goblins
header.description: “Inspired by Expandable Goblins by irritator-fan-nsfw, this add-on introduces a goblin that changes as it drinks, gradually altering its appearance and giving it a more reactive, evolving presence in your world.” **Source Mod**: Expandable Goblins (Java, Forge 1.20.1) https://irritator-fan-nsfw.itch.io/expandable-goblins
